name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I've spent the last eight years as a patient managing a chronic condition, fighting insurers through prior authorizations and appeals to get treatment and imaging approved. I know how much depends on someone catching the access problem before the patient has to, which is why a platform built around medication access caught my attention. Implementation is the work I know best: at Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with up to 25 in flight, at 110% of my implementation target.

The parts of this role I'd step into fastest are running parallel deployments and keeping technical work moving. At Accelo I built sequenced implementation plans, deciding which systems to change and in what order, and escalated blockers early instead of at the deadline. At Solenzo I set up and validate data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, and I debug integration failures myself, so I can follow an integration conversation and translate it for the people who need the outcome, not the detail.

Where I'd be learning is health system environments specifically, including EHR integrations like Epic and Cerner. My healthcare background is on the commercial side: four years at Senior Directory, a company focused on healthcare for seniors, and channel work with healthcare-focused agencies at Birdeye. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
